---
name: Add a problem or correct an entry
about: Suggest a source-backed result, caveat, or explanation
labels: ''
---

## Problem

Name or catalogue link; exact statement and assumptions if available.

## What changed?

Result, correction, new artifact, rediscovery, or attribution update; date (or the most precise known month/year).

## AI and human contributions

Who did what? What evidence supports that attribution?

## Sources

Primary paper, proof artifact (theorem/file and commit if known), and any commentary. For a mishap, include the correction or critique.

## Verification scope and caveats

What was checked, by whom, and with which tool/version? Which parts remain unchecked? Do not infer full formal coverage from a code link.
